description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four distinct data series. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 0 to 6 at intervals of 2, though the plotted data extends from approximately -0.8 to 7.4. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and utilizes a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 12 to 28 at intervals of 2, accompanied by horizontal dashed gridlines. The plot contains four lines, all demonstrating an upward trend across the x-axis. The "Consistency-CE" series is represented by a light purple dashed line with circular markers, starting at an x-value of approximately -0.5 with a y-value of 13.0, and rising steadily to end at x ≈ 7.3, y ≈ 26.4. The "Inconsistency-CE" series is depicted by a dark purple dashed line with square markers, beginning at x ≈ 0.6, y ≈ 20.0 and increasing to conclude at x ≈ 7.2, y ≈ 27.2. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" series is shown as a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at x ≈ 0.7, y ≈ 19.7, and ending at x ≈ 7.4, y ≈ 27.0. Finally, a fourth series, whose legend label is obscured by a gray rectangle, is plotted as a solid red line with star markers; it begins at x ≈ -0.8 with a y-value of 22.6 and rises to end at x ≈ 7.4, y ≈ 27.8.
